_about: G5 rubric for one labeled note (D-8). Seeded into G0's rubric store through G0's own loader; scored by G0's evaluation capability (DeterministicJudge + decide()). The item is an object built by quality.py from comparing the vault after a run with fixtures/labels.json: {type_match: yes|no, tags_recall: full|partial|none, tags_precision: full|partial|none, links_precision: full|partial|none|no_links}.

rubrics.title: Vault note: type right, expected tags present, no wrong tags, no wrong links
rubrics.source: g5-vault-gardener docs/prd.md (evaluation hook: hand-labeled sample for tagging and linking quality)

criteria.description: The note's type equals the label.
Every labeled tag is on the note.
Every tag on the note is a labeled tag.
Every link in the Related section is a labeled related note (a note with no links counts as clean).
